name: manpage-ai
description: Search and read version-aware Linux manual pages with exact distribution and package provenance.

interface.longDescription: Search and read Linux manual pages across indexed distributions, releases, repositories, architectures, and package versions with exact provenance.
defaultPrompt: Explain the Linux command I name using its manual page.
Find the manual page for a Linux topic or option.
Compare a command's manual across distributions or package versions.

positive.description: Discover the currently indexed operating-system targets before applying exact scope filters.
positive.prompt: Which Linux distributions, releases, repositories, and architectures can manpage.ai search right now? Include their document counts.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_targets once and summarize only the returned scope and count values without inventing unavailable targets.

positive.description: Retrieve and explain a version-specific command manual with package provenance.
positive.prompt: Using the Fedora 44 printf(1) manual, explain what printf does and identify the package version the answer came from.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_manual with manual_name=printf, distribution=fedora, release=44, and section=1; summarize the manual and report the returned Fedora and package/version provenance.

positive.description: Find relevant manuals from a natural-language topic rather than a known command name.
positive.prompt: Which Linux manual pages explain how to preserve file attributes while copying files? Give me the best two matches and their provenance.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with a nonblank multi-word query and limit=2; present only returned matches, snippets, distributions, packages, and versions.

positive.description: Look up exact manual-name alternatives without performing a full-text query.
positive.prompt: Find the first two indexed cp(1) manual entries and show which distribution and package each one belongs to.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with manual_name=cp, section=1, and limit=2 while omitting query; report the two returned entries and their exact provenance.

positive.description: Compare one manual across two supported distributions using live target discovery and explicit filters.
positive.prompt: Compare the package provenance for the ls(1) manual on Fedora 44 and Rocky Linux 10. Keep the manual behavior separate from the provenance comparison.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_targets to confirm exact scopes, then call get_manual for ls section 1 with Fedora 44 and Rocky 10 filters; compare only provenance returned by the tools and do not generalize one manual to every Linux release.

negative.description: The plugin documents commands but cannot install software or execute commands on the user's computer.
negative.prompt: Install the latest coreutils package on my computer and run ls for me.

negative.description: The corpus contains Linux manual pages, not Windows PowerShell documentation.
negative.prompt: Show me the official Windows PowerShell documentation for Get-ChildItem.

negative.description: The plugin cannot download packages or verify package signatures.
negative.prompt: Download the Fedora coreutils RPM and verify its signature for me.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with version-aware Linux manual search, indexed-target discovery, full manual retrieval, and exact distribution and package provenance.
